_comment: Mutation testing for the size30 bill and the daily draw (drive issue #642). Run it with `npm run mutate`; it is deliberately not part of `npm test` and not in CI, because one run takes minutes and the bill's tests are the only suite it needs. The scope is the two files that hold money: core/billing.js, where monthBillCents() is the one config-to-money function, and core/prepaid.js, where the daily draw reads it. Read the score and the survivors in reports/mutation/mutation.json, then kill what a test should have caught. There is no tsconfig to rewrite: nothing here builds TypeScript for the mutate run, and this repo's TypeScript 7 does not export the API Stryker's sandbox would rewrite it with.

commandRunner.command: node --test test/abuse-guards.test.mjs test/account-balance.test.mjs test/account-gate.test.mjs test/agent-caps.test.mjs test/bill-e2e.test.mjs test/billing.test.mjs test/calendar-month.test.mjs test/cap-enforcement.test.mjs test/cap-mount.test.mjs test/cap.test.mjs test/dodo.test.mjs test/draw-laws.test.mjs test/emails.test.mjs test/home-page.test.mjs test/meter-jobs.test.mjs test/meter-scale.test.mjs test/meter.test.mjs test/pricing-copy.test.mjs test/prepaid-pause.test.mjs test/quote.test.mjs test/size30.test.mjs test/usage.test.mjs test/integration/cap-mount-readonly.test.mjs test/integration/cap-store-d1.test.mjs test/integration/prepaid-d1.test.mjs test/integration/prepaid-pause-d1.test.mjs
commandRunner._comment: The tests that pin a money number or the saving copy (quoteForStoredTb, savedLine, monthBillCents, the draw). Files that only import a constant stay off this list so a mutate run stays minutes. test/billing.test.mjs fails if a test that calls quoteForStoredTb or billing savedLine is missing here.
